original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚早间要闻：EFCC在奥贡发现非法炼油厂，奥比支持者发生冲突
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚经济与金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）据称在奥贡州Ogere地区发现一处由中国公民运营的非法炼油厂。此外，支持彼得·奥比2027年总统竞选的相关团体之间出现新的分歧与冲突。上述消息来自Punch的早间要闻汇总，目前为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: EFCC在奥贡州Ogere地区发现一处非法炼油厂
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The EFCC has uncovered an illegal oil refinery allegedly operated by Chinese nationals in the Ogere area of Ogun State.

key_facts.fact: 该炼油厂据称由中国公民运营
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: an illegal oil refinery allegedly operated by Chinese nationals in the Ogere area of Ogun State

key_facts.fact: 支持彼得·奥比2027年总统竞选的团体之间出现新的分歧
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: fresh disagreements among groups supporting Peter Obi’s 2027 presidential ambition
